name: asaa-templates
description: ASAA Templates Platform — modular monolith (React/Vite web, Express/Prisma API, shared contracts).

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @asaa/api && npm run build -w @asaa/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @asaa/api" "npm run dev -w @asaa/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
